name: Novus Loyalty Ltd
title: Novus Loyalty Ltd - 544735 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Loyalty platform FY26 revenue ~127 Cr (+22%), EBITDA margin 9.68%, PAT margin 7.29%; management gives no numeric FY27 guidance beyond international revenue doubling and 15-20% India growth, with a thin, promotional Q&A.

triggers.label: Evasive on PAT and margin sustainability
triggers.quote: Margins will increase from where they are right now.

triggers.label: International revenue ~3.3 Cr to double
triggers.quote: we only got about 3.3 crore from the international market, but we are expecting to at least double the international market.

guidance.quote: we are expecting 15 -20% growth in Indian markets

guidance.value: at least double FY26 (~3.3 Cr), ~5 Cr FY27, >10 Cr FY28
guidance.quote: we are expecting to at least double the international market. At least double, if not triple.

red_flags.label: Revenue concentration in few large bank contracts, GeM-driven wins
red_flags.quote: we got an 88 Cr. from the GEM portal itself

red_flags.label: Unverified forward numbers and vague bid pipeline
red_flags.quote: There is no existing right now. One with the Canara was there, which got cancelled

red_flags.label: Management contradicts itself on P/E and margin claims
red_flags.quote: we are actually listed around 24, 25, I don't know.

evasions.quote: So, from IPO proceeds, it's gonna be, as planned. I think for business development and sales, like, it's, we can… I don't know the exact number
Margins will increase from where they are right now.
So the major issue is the loyalty discovery side of it.
